page.overview:
What is Taming beasts?

Taming beasts, also known as animal kinship or beast control, was an ability of the Force that allowed its user to connect mentally with animals.

Taming beasts, also known as animal kinship or beast control, Leia Organa was able to use the ability without even trying to, simply asking for help in a moment where she found the Force inside of herself. Organa's prior attempts to use the Force had failed because she had seen it as something outside of herself to be controlled.

During the Sith Empire's occupation of Serenno, the Sith used the Force to control the Tirra'Taka and use it in combat. During the High Republic Era, Jedi Master Porter Engle used this ability to calm a group of steelees so they could be used as mounts during a Jedi rescue attempt of the Blythe family, who had been kidnapped by the Nihil.

Obi-Wan Kenobi demonstrated a natural talent at the technique early in his training. He easily connected with his varactyl mount on Pijal, impressing his master Qui-Gon Jinn. In contrast Kenobi's apprentice Anakin Skywalker struggled to learn the skill, unable to calm a Mott during a training session and likewise failed to calm the corpse-leeches on Carnelion IV causing Skywalker to kill them instead.
